master: Minimal Pro: a beautifully precise calm architectural drafting workspace with graphite matte surfaces, one pale ivory desk positioned on the right, blank cream paper and diffuse daylight from a simple skylight. Almost monochrome with nuanced warm/cool greys and subtle paper texture. No characters, neon, decorative plants, sculptures or clutter. A broad empty softly shaded graphite wall occupies the left and centre; the right desk and skylight form a restrained geometric focal arrangement. Delicate refined architectural drawing/painting, believable perspective, editorial design quality, not a corporate office photograph. Gentle shadows do not cut across the heading zone. Original landscape16:9 architectural environment illustration for a premium local creative workspace skin. Target3840x2160 if natively supported; do not print dimensions. Keep the middle-left60% low-detail and low-contrast for real HTML headings, interesting subject nearx.78,y.65 with12% edge overscan. No text, letters, numbers, interface, buttons, icons, logos, watermarks, people or fake status elements. One finished scene, not a collage.
